declared_readings: Character attributes are stored beside the styles (style_character per style of either scope, character_overrides over story byte spans), not on StudioTypeStyle/StoryRange, so existing records and every struct literal keep their shape (the composition-settings precedent).
Resolution order: paragraph style based_on chain, character style based_on chain, local override (STU-TYP-201 reading). A record `size` wins over the legacy style font_size fields in the export.

The 157 booleans with a single registered tag (ligatures ... proportional_metrics, Type's LegacyBoolean mapping) live only in opentype_features (STU-TYP-174); the read projects them as legacy_booleans. overlap_swash, stretched_alternate, kana (hkna/vkna), italics, connection_forms and the non-OpenType booleans are stored fields.

STU-TYP-158 synthesis parameters are stored per record (the spec does not say document or range; InDesign holds them in text preferences, UNVERIFIED D5). Synthesised super/subscript is applied only when its size and position are stated (UNKNOWN defaults are not invented); a subscript position moves down. UNVERIFIED.
Built-in stroke styles: solid, dotted, wavy (STU-TYP-192 solid; STU-TYP-160 decoration styles). InDesign's default stroke style list UNVERIFIED (D5).
Hyperlink URLs refuse script and inline-data schemes (javascript, vbscript, data) and whitespace: a hostile-input reading, not spec text.

No stated language shapes as `und` (was `en`); a key without a record is used when it is a locale name (en_US, en-US), else `und` and applied_language_unresolved. A paragraph with no strong character is declared Latn (the vendored engine shapes Zyyy only for default-ignorables).
Tracking and manual kerning are added to every glyph advance of their span ((t + k) / 1000 em); InDesign applies manual kerning per pair at the insertion point (UNVERIFIED, D5).
Paragraph line height is the largest stated leading of its spans, else 1.25 em of each span's size (the editor's convention); ascent capped at the line height.
